::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Deuteronomy records Moses' final speeches, urging Israel to remember God's faithfulness and renew their covenant before entering the Promised Land. The book teaches that wholehearted love for God is demonstrated through faithful obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Deuteronomy 1:31
The LORD carried thee
### Why This Verse Summary of God's care ### Chapter Insight This chapter reviews Israel's journey from Horeb and their failure at Kadesh-barnea. The key verse highlights how unbelief delayed God's promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Deuteronomy 2:7
The LORD thy God hath been with thee
### Why This Verse Wilderness provision ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Israel's wilderness travels and victories east of the Jordan. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign guidance and provision. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Deuteronomy 3:22
The LORD shall fight for you
### Why This Verse Encouragement before conquest ### Chapter Insight This chapter records victories over Og and preparations to enter Canaan. The key verse reminds Israel that God fights for His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Deuteronomy 4:29
Seek the LORD and find Him
### Why This Verse Foundational promise of repentance ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls Israel to remember and obey God's laws. The key verse emphasizes the unique privilege of having God near to His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Deuteronomy 5:7
Thou shalt have no other gods
### Why This Verse Restatement of the Ten Commandments ### Chapter Insight This chapter restates the Ten Commandments for the new generation. The key verse underscores covenant obedience as the foundation of national life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Deuteronomy 6:4
Hear, O Israel: The LORD is one
### Why This Verse The Shema; among Judaism's most important verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches wholehearted devotion to God. The key verse presents the Great Commandment as the heart of covenant faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Deuteronomy 7:9
Know that the LORD is God
### Why This Verse Covenant faithfulness ### Chapter Insight This chapter explains Israel's calling as God's chosen people. The key verse highlights God's love and covenant faithfulness rather than Israel's merit. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Deuteronomy 8:3
Man shall not live by bread alone
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus during temptation ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns against forgetting God in times of prosperity. The key verse teaches dependence upon God's word above material provision. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Deuteronomy 9:5
Not for thy righteousness
### Why This Verse Grace over merit ### Chapter Insight This chapter reminds Israel that victory comes from God's grace, not their righteousness. The key verse warns against spiritual pride. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Deuteronomy 10:12
What doth the LORD require of thee
### Why This Verse Summary of covenant duty ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes God's mercy and His desire for heartfelt obedience. The key verse summarizes God's requirements for His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Deuteronomy 11:26
I set before you blessing and curse
### Why This Verse Central covenant choice ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts the blessings of obedience with the consequences of disobedience. The key verse urges Israel to choose God's blessing through faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Deuteronomy 12:5
The place the LORD shall choose
### Why This Verse Worship centralization ### Chapter Insight This chapter centralizes worship in the place God chooses. The key verse stresses worship according to God's instructions rather than personal preference. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Deuteronomy 13:4
Walk after the LORD your God
### Why This Verse Loyalty to God ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns against false prophets and idolatry. The key verse teaches loyalty to God above all other influences. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Deuteronomy 14:2
A holy people unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Covenant identity ### Chapter Insight This chapter distinguishes Israel as a holy people. The key verse connects everyday conduct with covenant identity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Deuteronomy 15:11
The poor shall never cease from the land
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted social teaching ### Chapter Insight This chapter outlines laws regarding debt release and generosity. The key verse reveals God's concern for compassion toward the needy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Deuteronomy 16:20
Justice, justice shalt thou pursue
### Why This Verse One of the most cited OT justice texts ### Chapter Insight This chapter reviews Israel's major feasts and principles of justice. The key verse highlights joyful worship and remembrance of God's redemption. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Deuteronomy 17:20
That his heart be not lifted up
### Why This Verse Kingship under God's law ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes guidelines for judges, priests, and kings. The key verse emphasizes submission to God's authority through appointed leadership. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Deuteronomy 18:15
A prophet like unto me
### Why This Verse Major messianic passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes God's provision of prophets and warns against pagan practices. The key verse promises a future prophet whom God's people must hear. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Deuteronomy 19:15
Two or three witnesses
### Why This Verse Frequently cited legal principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes cities of refuge and principles of justice. The key verse demonstrates God's concern for both mercy and fairness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Deuteronomy 20:4
The LORD goes with you to fight
### Why This Verse Divine warfare promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter provides laws for warfare. The key verse reminds Israel that victory comes from God's presence rather than military strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Deuteronomy 21:23
Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree
### Why This Verse Quoted by Paul in Galatians ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses various social and legal responsibilities. The key verse emphasizes justice and responsibility within the covenant community. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Deuteronomy 22:4
Thou shalt not hide thyself
### Why This Verse Responsibility toward neighbor ### Chapter Insight This chapter applies covenant principles to everyday life. The key verse illustrates God's concern for practical righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Deuteronomy 23:14
The LORD walks in the midst of thy camp
### Why This Verse Divine presence and holiness ### Chapter Insight This chapter regulates holiness within the camp and community. The key verse emphasizes that God's presence requires purity among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Deuteronomy 24:19
Leave some for the stranger, fatherless, widow
### Why This Verse Cornerstone of biblical charity ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains laws protecting marriage, workers, and the vulnerable. The key verse highlights God's concern for compassion and fairness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Deuteronomy 25:4
Thou shalt not muzzle the ox
### Why This Verse Quoted by Paul regarding ministry ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues laws regarding justice and community life. The key verse stresses integrity and honesty in all dealings. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Deuteronomy 26:18
A peculiar people unto Himself
### Why This Verse Covenant declaration ### Chapter Insight This chapter prescribes offerings of firstfruits and tithes. The key verse encourages gratitude by remembering God's faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Deuteronomy 27:26
Cursed is he that confirmeth not this law
### Why This Verse Quoted in Galatians ### Chapter Insight This chapter instructs Israel to renew the covenant upon entering Canaan. The key verse emphasizes public commitment to God's law. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Deuteronomy 28:1
If thou shalt diligently obey
### Why This Verse Opening of blessings and curses ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience. The key verse summarizes the consequences of covenant choices. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Deuteronomy 29:29
Secret things belong unto the LORD
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Deuteronomy ### Chapter Insight This chapter renews the covenant with a new generation. The key verse stresses personal responsibility before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Deuteronomy 30:19
Choose life
### Why This Verse Famous covenant appeal ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls Israel to choose life through obedience and faith. The key verse presents one of Scripture's clearest invitations to choose God's way. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Deuteronomy 31:6
Be strong and of good courage
### Why This Verse Widely quoted encouragement ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Moses' final instructions and Joshua's commissioning. The key verse encourages courage through God's abiding presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
Deuteronomy 32:4
He is the Rock, His work is perfect
### Why This Verse Foundational statement about God ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the Song of Moses. The key verse declares God's perfect faithfulness and justice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
Deuteronomy 33:27
The eternal God is thy refuge
### Why This Verse Beloved promise verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Moses' blessings upon the tribes. The key verse celebrates the security and blessing found in God alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
Deuteronomy 34:10
No prophet arose like Moses
### Why This Verse Conclusion of Moses' life ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Moses' death and Joshua's succession. The key verse honors Moses' unique role as God's servant and prophet. :::
